source.name: SportsPro: Barcelona thread '€60m' Midea sleeve sponsorship deal
source.quote: Spanish newspaper Mundo Deportivo reports that it is worth €12 million (US$14 million) per year.

note: SportsPro: 'Deal will run for five seasons through to 2030/31'; 'Financial terms of the deal were not officially disclosed', the fee is Mundo Deportivo's report. 2Playbook (2025-09-02, 'El Barça ficha a Midea para la manga de la camiseta hasta junio de 2031') also gives 2030-2031 as the end; its URL mentions 9 million a year, its text states no fee.
